rows.text: Once again, you bump into Oswaldo Schneider's disciple at the bazaar. You can smell his greed — he reeks of sulfur as he uses wholesale mineral bottles to save costs.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "The price difference is the fees you have to pay for the lesson, and no one can be the exception. The rule of thumb in business is to buy low and sell high. Master it, and you will never suffer a loss in the future," he says indifferently.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Now, let me teach you a thing or two about consumer psychology, which involves probability theory. A jackpot with a huge prize is irresistible to most people. I guarantee that you will strike the jackpot one day."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
